headline: EU Implements Handling Fee on Non-EU Parcels to Curb Influx
summary: The European Union will introduce a €2 handling fee on packages from outside the 27-nation bloc, adding to an existing €3 fee on small parcels to curb imports from China ahead of the holiday shopping season.
why: The European Union is a major economic bloc whose trade and regulatory policies directly affect cross-border e-commerce and retail margins.

impacts.name: Cross-Border E-Commerce
impacts.why: Additional handling fees increase the landed cost of non-EU parcels, potentially reducing cross-border retail order volumes.

why_moved: New administrative fees increase costs for foreign e-commerce shipments, impacting low-cost import volumes directly ahead of major shopping events.
